units.source_text: 来到河西岸，汽车、行人都绝迹了。

en.t: When we reached the west bank of the river, cars and pedestrians had disappeared completely.

units.source_text: 沿途不时地看见复桔园，却渺无人影。

en.t: Along the way we occasionally saw mandarin orange groves, but there was not a person in sight.

units.source_text: 那里有个名叫和江的小村庄，从那里欢然传来了拨开草丛的声音，原来是一只尖鼻的黑狗探出险来。

en.t: There was a small village there called Wae, and from it came the cheerful sound of grass being pushed aside; it turned out to be a sharp-nosed black dog poking its face out.
